description.text: Architecture is an interdisciplinary subject that studies architectural design, spatial planning, construction technology and architectural culture. It integrates artistic aesthetics, engineering technology and humanities and social sciences, aiming to cultivate professional talents with innovative capabilities in architectural design, practical technical skills and a sense of social responsibility. This major emphasizes the integration of theory and practice, covering fields such as architectural design, urban planning, heritage protection, and sustainable architecture. It serves as a bridge connecting the humanities and arts with engineering technology.

duration.text: The Architecture at Shenzhen University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5555 USD/per year ￥ 40000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Certificate and diploma of Master's degree. Graduates shall provide pre-graduation certificate. Those who have not graduated from master program submit a pre-graduation certificate which shows your expected graduation time and present your original certification, transcripts, and translations when you register.2. The transcripts of all courses during postgraduate period3.Two Letters of Recommendation (Signed by professors or associate professors in Chinese or English with the name of the referral and contact information)4. One piece of Self-statement (around 1500 words, and written in English or Chinese, and should include: the intended major and supervisor, personal experience of study and work, academic research results etc.)5. Photo Copy of Passport Info Page6. Passport Photo7.A Letter of Recommendation from potential supervisor.8. Language Proficiency Certificate（1）Programs taught in Chinese：①A minimum score of 180 in HSK4 certification for Science and Engineering②A minimum score of 180 in HSK5 certification for Liberal Arts, Medicine, Arts（2）Programs taught in English：English proficiency certificateNative speakers of Chinese or English can be exempted from the corresponding language proficiency certificate after being recognized by our university.9. Resume (from primary school to now)10.Foreigner Physical Examination Form11. Non-criminal Record Report (both original and Chinese translated copies)12. Applicants for Guangdong Government Outstanding International Student Scholarship, please download the form, fill it out and upload it.

requirements.text: 1. The applicant should be non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passports, and should be good in physical and mental health and shall abide by the laws and regulations of China and the rules of school.2. Applicants should hold Master’s degree or above, and should be under the age of 40. Applicants who have not graduated can provide expected graduation certificate for submitting application while the official diploma must be provided before enrollment.3. Applicants should meet the corresponding language level requirements (The language proficiency certificate must be within the validity period).（1）Programs taught in Chinese：①A minimum score of 180 in HSK4 for Science and Engineering②A minimum score of 180 in HSK5 for Liberal Arts, Medicine, Arts（2）Programs taught in English：English proficiency certificationNative speakers of Chinese or English can be exempted from the corresponding language proficiency certificate after being recognized by our university.
